source.title: Irish News, 19 May 1949, p. 3 ("Rural council nominations")
source.publisher: Irish News (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)

note: Triennial election of the district electoral divisions of Ballymoney rural district, one member each, polled on 2 June 1949. The Irish News nomination list of 19 May gives the retiring members returned for nine divisions; contests were pending in Seacon and Kirkmoyle, whose results were not found in the Belfast or Irish News reports, so those two divisions are not listed here. Returned unopposed.
correctionNote: Renamed from 'Ballybregagh' to Ballycregagh (19 Nov 2026, w19-tidy, the owner's decision 4 of 19 Nov 2026: a division filed under two spellings takes its official name, and each round keeps the spelling it was filed under as Constituency_Name_As_Printed): the 1911 DED map (Ballymoney Rural District) and the Northern Ireland DED maps of 1921-69 name the DED Ballycregagh; the rounds were filed as Ballycregagh (1930, 1964); Ballyeraigagh (1946); Ballybregagh (1949). This round was filed as 'Ballybregagh', kept as Constituency_Name_As_Printed; the old address (ballybregagh) answers with a redirect to this one.
